title: Savta ben Alem
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sanhedrin 64a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.64a.13): he worshipped Pe’or unwittingly. Hyman says it is not known whether he was a Torah scholar. (Hyman reports [Rashi’s explanation](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Sanhedrin.64a.13.2) of Alem as a place-name.)[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Sanhedrin has Alas (אלס). Hyman gives Alem (אלם).
The linked Rashi explicitly reads Alas, with a samekh, and explains it as a place-name. Hyman leaves Savta’s scholarly status open.
